findings.issue: AngularNodeAppEngine is configured with allowedHosts: ['*'], contradicting current SSR guidance to keep an explicit host list and avoid wildcards even behind a proxy.
findings.suggestion: Configure the expected hosts (or document/proxy-validate Host at the edge and keep an explicit allow-list); keep the comment about why Host is not used for data fetching.

findings.issue: `void this.load(names)` inside the effect swallows failures: a non-404 /_data error becomes an unhandled promise rejection and the page silently shows a stale team VM.
findings.suggestion: Catch inside load(), set an error signal, and render a retry message on the team page.

findings.issue: withEventReplay() is redundant on Angular v22 — provideClientHydration() already enables incremental hydration plus event replay by default.
findings.suggestion: Drop withEventReplay() and rely on the v22 defaults (keep provideClientHydration()).

findings.issue: Cookie sync is one-directional (localStorage→cookie only when non-empty); a surviving cookie with cleared localStorage makes SSR render a team the client doesn't have, causing hydration mismatch.
findings.suggestion: On the browser, always make localStorage authoritative by writing the cookie from whatever was read (including empty), or read the cookie as the browser fallback.

findings.issue: The client cache is TTL-bounded but not size-bounded, unlike the server cache's MAX_ENTRIES=4000; entries linger until re-read.
findings.suggestion: Add a max-entries eviction like server/api-client.ts, or prune expired entries on set.

findings.issue: Router's built-in scroll restoration and anchor scrolling are disabled and re-implemented by hand over Scroll events; dense, must be studied to trust.
findings.suggestion: Prefer withInMemoryScrolling({scrollPositionRestoration:'top', anchorScrolling:'enabled'}) if it satisfies the spec, or keep the custom logic but move it into a small directive/service with tests.

findings.issue: Page number is clamped to pageCount for display while the URL keeps the out-of-range ?page value, so URL and shown page disagree.
findings.suggestion: Either navigate to the clamped page or treat out-of-range as page 1 in the URL as well.

findings.issue: Uses the legacy @Injectable() while the rest of the app uses the v22-stable @Service(); inconsistent and will be flagged by the ng generate @angular/core:service migration.
findings.suggestion: Use @Service({autoProvided: false}) or no decorator since it's registered via useClass.

findings.issue: Near-identical TTL/promise-cache logic duplicated across server/api-client.ts and app/data/page-data.ts with slightly different eviction behavior.
findings.suggestion: Extract one tiny shared promise-cache helper (usable on both sides) or consciously document the two different policies.

summary: This is a confident, current-Angular codebase: v22 idioms (@Service, signal inputs, linkedSignal, resolvers with component input binding, RESPONSE_INIT 404s, per-request SSR) with a clean server/client boundary built on a shared view-model contract, and the team-builder feature lands as a model-minimal diff. Remaining issues are small: a wildcard allowedHosts against official guidance, one swallowed rejection on the team page, a narrow cookie/localStorage hydration edge, and a few redundant or duplicated bits. I'd merge after one round of nits.
